agency.agency: New Jersey Housing and Mortgage Finance Agency (NJHMFA)

programs.name: NJHMFA Down Payment Assistance (with the First-Time Homebuyer Mortgage)

amount.text: up to $15,000 or $10,000 depending on the county

programs.repayment: no interest, no monthly payments; forgiven if you live in the home as your principal residence for five years from closing and do not refinance or otherwise convey the first mortgage
programs.firstTimeNote: no ownership interest in a primary residence during the previous three years; Urban Target Areas and qualified veterans exempt

incomeLimit.text: 100% AMI (1-2 persons) and 115% AMI (3+) by county, effective June 17, 2026; higher in Urban Target Areas

programs.sourceTitle: NJHMFA consumer fact sheet, updated June 17, 2026
programs.quote: The DPA is forgiven if the Borrower continuously resides in the premises as his/her principal residence for five years from the loan closing date

programs.name: NJHMFA First Generation Down Payment Assistance

amount.text: $7,000 on top of the NJHMFA DPA, for a total of $17,000 to $22,000

programs.repayment: interest-free, five-year forgivable second loan with no monthly payment
programs.firstTimeNote: first-time buyers who are also first-generation buyers (parents or legal guardians own no residential property)
programs.quote: provides $7,000 of down payment and closing cost assistance. This is offered in addition to the NJHMFA DPA award for first-time buyers providing a total assistance of $17,000 to $22,000
